messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary failure rate for release r-2026-03-17 (model-serving) in eu-west-1 crossed threshold (18% errors, threshold 10%). Automated rollback attempted at 2026-03-17T02:13:09Z and returned partial success. Paging on-call. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failure

oliver: oncall here, seeing the alert. checking rollout dashboard now — link?

eng-release: dashboard https://dash.internal/releases/r-2026-03-17 — canary traffic at 15% now, errors spike aligns with 02:10 UTC

anya: logs show `model-serving` 503s from upstream timeout in instance set canary-eu-1. Sample: ```
ERROR 02:11:02 handler.go:142 timeout waiting for model host instance-42
```

oliver: automated rollback tried `releasectl rollback r-2026-03-17 --auto` but exited 1/3 regions due to drain timeout on eu-west-1. Need manual rollback for that region.

bharat: customer impact? From observability, user-facing error rate on hosted API increased from 0.3% -> 2.2% for EU region. Small but visible to a subset; support ticket #S-792 attached.

oliver: OK, plan: 1) stop canary traffic to eu-west-1 (flag flip), 2) trigger manual rollback for canary instances, 3) verify smoke and latency metrics, 4) update status. Who can flip the flag ASAP?

anya: I can flip flag now. Doing: `featureflagctl set canary-r-2026-03-17 false --region eu-west-1`

incident-bot: ACTION: Feature flag `canary-r-2026-03-17` set to false in eu-west-1 by anya at 02:18:03Z

oliver: good. now performing manual rollback for eu-west-1: `releasectl rollback r-2026-03-17 --region eu-west-1 --force --drain-timeout 30s` — running.

eng-release: note: some pods failed termination due to pre-stop hook hang. If rollback doesn't succeed, we may need to cordon and recreate nodes.

anya: rollback command returned exit code 0 for eu-west-1, old revision r-2026-03-16 restored to 100% for that region.

oliver: running smoke tests: `curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.ai/healthz && curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` — first returns 200, generation latency 120ms, sample response looks good.

bharat: customer-impact update: support notified, ticket updated to say canary traffic removed and rollback applied. No broad data loss; some requests retried during 02:10-02:18 window.

eng-release: checking metrics: error rate back to baseline 0.35% in eu-west-1 over last 5m, p95 latency stable. Canary health for other regions OK. Automated rollback logs show drain timeout due to pre-stop hook; file bug: #BUG-1245.

oliver: filing bug and follow-up action: disable problematic pre-stop hook for canary hosts, add additional draining visibility. Assigning to eng-release.

maria: morning on-call here (handing over). Summary for next shift: partial automated rollback failed on eu-west-1 due to pre-stop hook hang, manual rollback and flag pull succeeded, metrics back to baseline, support ticket S-792 opened, follow-up bug BUG-1245 assigned. Please verify post-deploy telemetry for next 2 hours.

oliver: thanks. leaving channel for handoff — I'll update runbook with exact commands used. If anything flips, page me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. Root cause investigation and postmortem requested.
